svg.title: Northwind relational model
svg.desc: Thirteen tables form a commerce system spanning sales, catalog, fulfillment, organization, and customer segmentation.
svg.metadata: Northwind relational model. Thirteen tables form a commerce system spanning sales, catalog, fulfillment, organization, and customer segmentation. 13 nodes and 13 relationships. Customers foreign key Orders (places). Employees foreign key Orders (owns). Shippers foreign key Orders (ships via). Orders foreign key Order Details (contains). Products foreign key Order Details (ordered as). Categories foreign key Products (classifies). Suppliers foreign key Products (supplies). Employees foreign key Employees (reports to). Employees foreign key Employee Territories (assigned). Territories foreign key Employee Territories (covered by). Region foreign key Territories (contains). Customers foreign key Customer Customer Demo (segmented as). Customer Demographics foreign key Customer Customer Demo (categorizes).

g.text: Thirteen tables form a commerce system spanning sales, catalog, fulfillment, organization, and customer segmentation.

g.aria-label: Sales and customers.
Product catalog.
Organization and territories.
Customer segmentation.
places from customers to orders.
owns from employees to orders.
ships via from shippers to orders.
contains from orders to order-details.
ordered as from products to order-details.
classifies from categories to products.
supplies from suppliers to products.
reports to from employees to employees.
assigned from employees to employee-territories.
covered by from territories to employee-territories.
contains from region to territories.
segmented as from customers to customer-customer-demo.
categorizes from customer-demographics to customer-customer-demo.
Customers. Organizations that place orders.
Orders. Commercial orders placed by customers.
Order Details. Products, quantities, prices, and discounts for an order.
Products. Sellable products and their inventory state.
Categories. Product classification and presentation data.
Suppliers. Organizations that supply products.
Shippers. Carriers responsible for order delivery.
Employees. Staff members who own orders and report to other employees.
Employee Territories. Associates employees with sales territories.
Territories. Sales territories belonging to a region.
Region. Top-level geographic sales regions.
Customer Demographics. Reusable descriptions of customer segments.
Customer Customer Demo. Associates customers with demographic segments.
